entries.text: A care for the poor is a characteristic of the righteous.
We should defend the poor and deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
If one of your brethren becomes poor and falls into poverty among you, you are to sustain him, whether he be a foreigner or a countryman.
Do not harden your heart towards the poor but lend to him sufficient to cover his need.
You are not to mock the poor.
You shall not oppress the poor.
He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker, but he who honors his Maker has mercy towards the needy.
Neglect towards to poor and hungry is a neglect of Christ.
The poor you will always have with you.
He who neglects the needy does not have the love of God in him.
Curses and punishments are due to those who neglect the poor or withhold from him his needs.
God will bless and deliver him that gives consideration to the poor.
He that is gracious to a poor man lends to God, and He will repay him for his good deed.
We should give of that which we have extra to the poor.
The poor will never cease out of the land, therefore open your hand wide to your poor brethren.
